reviewer: independent fixed local Git archive; read-only runtime integration review
build: NOT RUN: native acceptance agent uses current dist
native: Separate independent agent; not performed by this reviewer

findings.title: Late first DOM mount never reevaluates automatic eligibility
findings.trigger: Cache read succeeds empty while no prompts are mounted; a first stable user mounts after hydration and no user interaction occurs.
findings.actual: MutationObserver queue callback calls collect and render, but never maybeAutomatic. No automatic timer is created, and unchanged-route timer does not refresh.
findings.expected: Reevaluate automatic eligibility after later DOM observations.
findings.recommendation: Call maybeAutomatic after queue collect/render, or use refresh in that callback; test DOM appearing after cache hydration.

findings.title: Navigation waiting for initial hydration escapes cancellation
findings.trigger: Manual collection/build invoked while hydration is pending, then Esc/Stop cancellation or SPA A to B to A before hydration resolves.
findings.actual: Navigation token and pending operation are created only after awaiting hydration; continuation checks only same route and alive, so the cancelled command can start after the read completes.
findings.expected: Cancellation or route visit change invalidates the waiting command.
findings.recommendation: Capture request token/visit and expose cancellable preparing state before awaiting hydration; validate that token after the wait.

findings.title: Old reset acknowledgement leaves new-route cache scheduling stuck
findings.trigger: A rebuild waits for reset acknowledgement; SPA switches to B, loads its cache, observes a new prompt and schedules a save; A reset acknowledgement then arrives.
findings.actual: Schedule is blocked by rebuilding and captures the current cacheRevision. Stale reset finally clears rebuilding but does not schedule because its generation is obsolete. Subsequent same-revision schedule returns, leaving no timer or writes.
findings.expected: B observations are automatically saved after old work is abandoned.
findings.recommendation: Track rebuilding ownership by generation and drain current pending scheduling when its blocking owner leaves.

recommendations.title: Require a mounted stable user for automatic claim
recommendations.reason: IndexStore.mounted includes transient IDs; mounted.size alone can start before any stable collection anchor exists.

limitations: Authenticated ChatGPT LIVE validation has not been performed; native fixture results from a separate agent do not establish current ChatGPT DOM behavior.
